checks.evidence: Unchanged from the first review. Fold, runtime-contract and kernel-pin proofs live in execution_domain, execution_runtime and execution with fixture relations, and no added engine line names a rule, Ruff, Python or Django.

(a) invalid_patterns now matches every Operation variant, with no wildcard. Replace and SourceMatches literal patterns make input 0 fallible when they do not compile (presence/narrowing.rs:93-95). R6 is tied to the raisers: every RowFallible verdict names its raising operations (REGEX includes Pattern(Replace) and Pattern(SourceMatches), presence/service_test.rs:437-445), and every_fault_has_a_verdict asserts each raiser declares its input through prepare_for or invalid_patterns. My Replace plant was re-run on db950ed280 (pattern "(" in the Symbol Replace of row_errors_upstream_keep_the_rule_running, on the file where its join conjunct is absent): it now reports InvalidRegex. The test's own next assertion, 'the Symbol Replace never ran', then fails, as it should. New tests an_invalid_replace_pattern_is_reported_where_its_input_has_rows and an_invalid_select_pattern_is_reported_where_its_input_has_rows (presence_service_test.rs:567, :589) cover it. (b) The presence read is admission's first read. A successful read is pinned through RelationOwner::source (file_execution/presence/service.rs:25-37), so admission's re-read refuses a changed population: the Changed fixture is back to counts[0] > 1 with calls [2, 0]. A refusal is recorded (refuse_source) and admission returns it without calling the provider (source_admission/acquisition/service.rs:48-50, the only admission read site). The one-read assertions are restored in union_rows (left refusal), provider Missing::First, axis and readiness. (c) The SpanBetween continue is gone. compare_emptied (conformance_driver/test.rs:34) empties an input as Difference(A, A), whose presence is A's, so the region runs and the kernel answers for every kind.
No crate boundary crossed. The AbsentRoots::decided advisory is closed with a reason: execution_runtime constructs it, so pub(crate) cannot serve.
One source-read path: presence reads through RelationOwner::source and the runtime's refusal record, which admission consults. One origin propagation and one comparison evaluator, as before.
RegionCount moved from readiness to executable_program types, which both the domain fold and the runtime use. Domain does not reach application.
SourceRefusal and refuse_source are production state the admission path reads, not test seams. The test-only probes remain #[cfg(test)].

adapted_order_checks: Accepted. provider/test.rs Missing::Second (:186-206) and union_rows/mod.rs right-refusal branch (:288-300) no longer require the refused right side to be read last. They still require the left side first, exactly one right-side read, and no other relation. The order property they drop belongs to admission's lazy demand; presence reads in formula order before admission, and the single-read and error assertions still bound the provider calls and the outcome.
advisory_reasons: AbsentRoots::decided cross-crate: accepted (pub is required). relation:Annotates in unfed.toml: kept, with the stated follow-up of a replay file on which its rules' formula holds.
